issuer: the Rwanda National Police (testing and licensing), applied for and paid through Irembo
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Rwanda National Police's own site (police.gov.rw). A definitive driving licence, needed to drive without a supervisor, follows the practical driving test; an applicant must be 18 or above and hold a valid provisional driving licence (itself from 18, after the theory test, valid one year), so the definitive licence is held from 18. The definitive licence is valid for ten years. The fee for the licence card is applied for and paid online through Irembo, whose service page didn't answer from here, and the police's pages give no amount, so the fee is null. A foreign licence is exchanged only after an assessment that may require the theory or practical test, so no exchange list is held. The identity card is the National Identification Agency's, the ids engine's.

sources.title: Rwanda National Police, Definitive Driving License
sources.said: A definitive driving license is needed before you drive on the road without a supervisor (Co-driver). ... Who can apply for a definitive driving license? You must be 18 and above, have a valid provisional driving license and have taken driving courses. ... To apply and pay a fee online via Irembo

sources.title: Rwanda National Police, Provisional Driving License (PDL)
sources.said: You must be at least 18 years old before you can apply for your provisional driving license. ... Your provisional license will expire after one (1) years.

sources.title: Rwanda National Police, Renewal Definitive Driving License
sources.said: Your definitive driving license is valid for Ten (10) years.

sources.title: Rwanda National Police, Exchanging a Foreign Driving License
sources.said: Exchanging a foreigner driving license is not automatic. You may need to pass a theoretical or practical driving test, depending on the assessment.
